params.1273: Kill a warped fly while fighting in a style which gives Strength experience.
params.1274: You will find your combat styles in the sidebar marked with a pair of crossed swords.
params.1275: Click on a style to switch to it. Different weapons have different combat styles.
params.1276: Warped flies can be found in the Lumbridge Catacombs.
params.1277: You must have completed The Blood Pact quest to access the catacombs.
params.2225: Increasing your Strength level will improve your capacity to deal melee damage.
